about: The game's credits: the one source client/scripts/credits.mjs builds the in-game Credits panel and client/public/assets/CREDITS.md from (the sound rows come from client/public/audio/CREDITS.md, the code libraries from client/package.json and the Rust crates of the WebAssembly). The full records stay in art/CREDITS.md and art/CREDITS-makehuman.md; client/scripts/credits.test.mjs checks the two agree. Not an asset build input: editing it never changes the asset fingerprint.

licences.what: Art sources (art/) and the character models and hair built from them

sections.title: Character models
sections.intro: The two bodies keep our own mesh, skeleton and paint; their proportions come from these sculpts, and their topology, shape keys and weights from MakeHuman.

entries.work: Anime boy male model T-pose base basic FREE
entries.author: ALexzart
entries.note: The male body's shape. Adapted: retopologised onto our base mesh, posed, smoothed.

entries.author: DJP3D
entries.note: The female body's shape. Adapted: retopologised onto our base mesh, posed, smoothed.

entries.work: MakeHuman base mesh, targets, rig, weights and skin masks (MPFB 2)
entries.author: The MakeHuman team
entries.note: The bodies' topology, shape keys, expressions and skin weights.

sections.title: Hair
sections.intro: The eleven hairstyles are our own meshes derived from Meshy-generated models (meshy.ai), generated for this project by Philip Nguyen: segmented, fitted to our heads, cleaned and re-topologised.

entries.author: Philip Nguyen, derived from Meshy-generated models (meshy.ai)
entries.note: Short Tousled, Side-Swept Fringe, Shaggy Layers, Swept-Back Undercut, Tied-Back Ponytail, Crew Cut, Long with Bangs, High Ponytail, Bob with Front Locks, Twin Tails and Low Side Braid.

entries.work: Universal Animation Library: Walk_Loop and Sprint_Loop
entries.author: Quaternius
entries.note: The walk and run, retargeted onto our rig. Every other animation is our own.
